metrics.profile_summary: Senior Full Stack Digital Marketer specializing in eCommerce growth and performance marketing. Expert in managing full-funnel campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok to drive ROAS and customer acquisition.

experience.description: Managed paid ads across Meta, Google, and TikTok, oversaw Shopify operations, and led creative teams to optimize customer acquisition and brand growth.
Directed digital marketing for the East Africa market, managing Meta and Google campaigns and coordinating seasonal brand communication strategies.
Led performance marketing and eCommerce operations across Shopify and multiple marketplaces, managing PR and influencer collaborations.
Executed multi-channel campaigns, managed social media content calendars, and implemented SEO strategies to enhance brand visibility.
Developed online campaigns for travel packages, managed social media content, and conducted market research on competitor offerings.

strengths: Expertise in Meta and TikTok advertising
Proven experience in content calendar and creative team management
Strong data-driven approach to reporting and ROAS
weaknesses: Potentially overqualified for a Specialist role
No explicit mention of Canva or Excel
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly experienced digital marketer who exceeds the 2-year requirement and possesses advanced skills in the exact platforms (Meta, TikTok) and tasks (content scheduling, agency coordination) required.
